_readme: Copy the `domains` key (and optionally `weakPrimaryFloor`) into ~/.hicortex/config.json on the SERVER machine.
Domains are your top-level memory spheres. Each memory gets multiple weighted tags plus a derived primary.
They can be life areas OR project/topic areas — edit to match how YOU think.
The `domains` list below is the generic default that `hicortex init` scaffolds automatically.
There is NO fallback category: memories that fit nothing are handled automatically (weak-primary floor + decay).
Backfill an existing corpus with: hicortex classify-domains

domains.name: Work
domains.description: Your job and professional life — employer, clients, workstreams

domains.name: Personal
domains.description: Private life — home, hobbies, everyday matters

domains.name: People
domains.description: Relationships — family, friends, social life, network

_readme: A narrower life-sphere set for users who want tighter buckets.
The PRIMARY domain is derived by argmax association weight (LLM tag order breaks ties) — no manual override flag.
`weakPrimaryFloor` (default 0.45) is the minimum embedding similarity for a no-fit memory to earn a weak primary; tune it from your corpus.

domains.name: Work
domains.description: Employer, day job, client projects, workstreams

domains.name: Personal
domains.description: Private life — home, hobbies, everyday matters

domains.name: People
domains.description: Relationships — family, friends, social life, network

domains.name: Photography
domains.description: Camera gear, shoots, editing workflow, photo projects
